title: A live detached worker or benchmark launcher shows as an orphan in kbmon and backlog.py procs
goal: bl_procs classes a process whose parent is gone but which leads its own process group (started with start_new_session) and still has a live child as detached, not orphan, so kbmon raises no orphan alert for it and backlog.py procs and selfcheck name no orphan for it; a process left behind with no live child, or in another's group, is still an orphan

run:
import json,os,shutil,signal,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
os.makedirs('_cache',exist_ok=True);d=tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='detached-',dir='_cache')
L="import subprocess,time;c=subprocess.Popen(['sleep','90']);time.sleep(90)"
M=("import subprocess,sys;n=subprocess.DEVNULL;a=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-c',sys.argv[1]],start_new_session=True,stdout=n,stderr=n);"
   "b=subprocess.Popen(['sleep','90'],stdout=n,stderr=n);print(a.pid,b.pid)")
det,orph=[int(x) for x in s.run([sys.executable,'-c',M,L],cwd=d,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split()];ok=False
try:
    time.sleep(1.5)
    P=json.loads(s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--json','--panel','sessions'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120).stdout)['panels']['sessions']['data']['procs']
    k={p['pid']:p['class'] for p in P};print('detached launcher',k.get(det),'plain orphan',k.get(orph))
    ok=k.get(det)=='detached' and k.get(orph)=='orphan'
finally:
    for f in (lambda:os.killpg(det,signal.SIGKILL),lambda:os.kill(orph,signal.SIGKILL)):
        try:f()
        except OSError:pass
    shutil.rmtree(d,ignore_errors=True)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

clauses.clause: bl_procs classes a process whose parent is gone but which leads its own process group (started with start_new_session) and still has a live child as detached, not orphan, so kbmon raises no orphan alert for it and backlog.py procs and selfcheck name no orphan for it
a process left behind with no live child, or in another's group, is still an orphan
